paper_title: Distilling Empathy from Large Language Models
caption: GPT-4o vs. Base LLaMA-3.1-8B & Mistral-7B-v0.3 in empathetic responses as judged by Gemini
model_annotation: This chart represents the win rate, expressed as a percentage, for GPT-4o, LLaMA, and Mistral in empathetic responses as judged by Gemini. The pie chart contains four slices, each labeled with a model name and corresponding percentage. The slice labeled “GPT-4o” is a dark blue color and occupies 96.8% of the chart, while the slice labeled “GPT-4o” in the central circle is a dark red color and occupies 98.4% of the chart. The slice labeled “LLaMA” is a light gray color and represents 3.2% of the chart. Finally, the slice labeled “Mistral” is a dark red color and represents 1.2% of the chart. Percentage labels are displayed directly within each slice. The slices appear to be ordered visually from largest to smallest, moving clockwise starting with the outer dark blue slice. A legend is not present, but each slice is directly labeled.
